  (φ : QuaternaryQuadraticForms.RealVector3 → ℝ),

    Measurable φ →

          MeasureTheory.Measure.map (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.surfaceGraph φ)

              ENNReal.ofReal (QuaternaryQuadraticForms.graphAreaFactor φ y))
